As soon as you know where you want to go, all you need is the right public transport ticket. From single tickets to group tickets - you can find many tickets in the hvv app and conveniently buy them on the go as mobile tickets. 

7 % DISCOUNTS ON MOBILE TICKETS 
Pay for your public transport tickets online via PayPal, SEPA direct debit or credit card and save 7% compared to buying them at a ticket machine or on the bus. Weekly and monthly tickets and the Hamburg CARD are excluded. The displayed price of the ticket already includes the discount.  

BOOKMARK DESTINATIONS & LINES  
For even more convenience, you can save stops and addresses as favourites. You can also save frequently used locations, such as work or home, to navigate to them with one click from the home screen. This saves you time when planning your route and makes it even easier to start your journey. 

DEPARTURES NEAR YOU 
You know where to go? We’ll show you when to go! The hvv app shows you the departures of all lines at the stops in your area. Just swipe down on the home screen of the app and find out about current departures. This way, you can easily see when you have to hop on and save yourself the search for connections. Always be up to date in public transport. 

ENABLE CONTACTS & SHARE CONNECTIONS 
Enable your contacts in the app and select your destination in the route planner directly from your address book. Share your connection if needed or add it to your calendar. 

TRAVEL INFO & DISRUPTION MESSAGES 
Always stay up to date. All messages for your favourite lines are clearly displayed under "Messages". In addition, you can create alarms for lines, weekdays and time periods and be warned of disruptions via push messages. Whether it's construction work, closures, or cancellations, with the hvv app, you are informed in every situation. 

Do you still have questions? Our chatbot will be happy to help you. 

ALSO INTERESTING  
Do you want even more flexibility? Then why not try out the hvv switch app and also make use of offers from the mobility providers MOIA, MILES, SIXT share, SHARE NOW, TIER, and Voi; all in just one app. 

FEEDBACK  
Our goal is to make mobility by public transport in Hamburg as comfortable as possible. To improve the hvv app, we need your feedback. Write us your opinion and suggestions to app-feedback@hvv.de.
